title: Federated content checker: add a control mode and reject baselines with empty trees
description: Follow-up from the OMARK-93 Stage 1 review (claude-opus-5-5, APPROVE at 94f05edb), not started. Finding 1, tooling half: "either add a control mode to the checker or reword this AC template. The AC asked for something the tool cannot do." The literal v0.13.0 positive control in the same invocation cannot run because checkMarketplace resolves only the refs in marketplace.json and check-federated-content.mjs:100 rejects any baseline whose ref is not the pin. NIT 5 (pre-existing): "A baseline whose trees is empty or missing passes and counts as verified, with nothing compared. Possible follow-up: require at least one tree per in-scope baseline." (check-federated-content.mjs:104-111). Needs a plan word before starting.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A baseline whose trees is empty or missing fails the checker by name, and the same entry with a tree recorded still passes (OMARK-93 review NIT 5).
The control-mode half of finding 1 is decided and delivered: either a checker control mode, or the AC template reworded. Held for the leader decision; not built here.

implementationNotes: Half 1 (empty or missing baseline trees rejected) is built with two new assertions in scripts/test/check-federated-content.test.mjs; with the guard restored to dev both fail, and the live checker still passes 9 of 9 (node scripts/check-federated-content.mjs, run bare). Half 2 (control mode vs rewording the AC template) is a design choice and is put to the leader as an A/B question rather than settled here, so the task stays In Progress.

AC2 delivered as option A, DEC-227 (opum-doc, relayed by the leader): no control mode is built (B declined). The pin-bump playbook in docs/reference/federated-pin-verification.md now asks for (i) the check-federated-content.test.mjs run, whose repointed-tag case is the mismatch proof, and (ii) the live run summary line on the same change, quoted, naming the bumped entry among those "resolved and matched their baseline". Approval of half 1 at 01a2e88 is by opum-doc (Opus, by ref).
finalSummary: Half 1: the federated content checker now fails a baseline whose trees is empty or missing (OMARK-93 review NIT 5); two new assertions in scripts/test/check-federated-content.test.mjs, both red with the guard removed, tests 10/10 at the PR head, live checker 9 of 9 run bare; opum-doc Opus approved #224 at 01a2e88. Half 2: option A under DEC-227, no control mode; the pin-bump playbook in docs/reference/federated-pin-verification.md now asks for the test run and the quoted live summary line naming the bumped entry. Evidence covers 01a2e88 plus a docs and tracker only commit; CI is cited at the PR head.
